uncertain: U08267: Hakaider's 奴 (the one stronger than him) rendered "he" (White Eagle Musasabi, who appears next).

U08290-U08303: multiple speakers, same surgery line; first-person variants (俺/私) all rendered "I".
U08302/U08303: 死んじゃったら — "he" = Dr. Komyoji (the patient).
